title: The Final Static Again
author: P. M. Sandoval
blurb: Isandro Pemberton, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
